question: What rank does the adventurer known as Ironwood hold?
gold_sql: SELECT rank FROM members WHERE handle='Ironwood'

question: How many quests take place in the Frostpeak area?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quests WHERE region='Frostpeak'

question: What are the names of all the hard quests?
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM quests WHERE difficulty='hard'

question: Which quests has the adventurer Ironwood completed?
gold_sql: SELECT q.title FROM quests q JOIN completions c ON q.id=c.quest_id JOIN members m ON m.id=c.member_id WHERE m.handle='Ironwood'

question: Where does the adventurer who finished the quest called 'Hollow Root' live?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.home_city FROM members m JOIN completions c ON m.id=c.member_id JOIN quests q ON q.id=c.quest_id WHERE q.title='Hollow Root'

question: What is the total reward earned by Ironwood across all the quests they have finished?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(q.reward_gp) FROM quests q JOIN completions c ON q.id=c.quest_id JOIN members m ON m.id=c.member_id WHERE m.handle='Ironwood'

question: Which area has the most quests?
gold_sql: SELECT region FROM quests GROUP BY region ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many adventurers signed up in the year 1203?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE joined_year=1203
